description: Create or update a milestone — a dated marker, typically a release, that runs and cases are grouped under. With `id` it updates, without it creates. Existing milestones come back from qase_project_context. Cost: one API call, about 0.5s.

id.description: Milestone ID — if provided, updates; if omitted, creates

name: qase_milestone_upsert
title: Create or update milestone
